name: Air Fryer Paneer Tikka Rice Bowls

components.name: Paneer Tikka & Vegetables

ingredients.name: Packaged paneer cubed into bite-sized pieces

steps: Whisk yogurt, measured oil, lemon, spices, garlic and ginger into a tikka marinade; coat paneer, pepper and onion and chill 30 minutes.
Preheat air fryer to 190 C; arrange paneer and vegetables in a single layer without crowding, cooking in batches.
Air fry 10-14 minutes, turning halfway, until peppers are tender and paneer lightly coloured; avoid excessive time or paneer becomes rubbery.
Pack cooked paneer tikka over rice with yogurt sauce in separate chilled tubs; freeze only if paneer texture is acceptable after thawing.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Rinse rice and cook in measured water until fluffy, resting covered.

components.name: Mint Yogurt Sauce

ingredients.name: Plain Greek yogurt for chilled mint sauce

steps: Blend 150 g reserved yogurt and fresh mint into a cold sauce; never reuse paneer-contact marinade cold.

Refrigerate at 4 C or colder for up to 3-4 days; freeze later-week portions promptly. If freshly prepared salad is included, prepare and store separately.
Reheat previously cooked leftovers to 74 C, stirring and checking the centre. For egg dishes, ensure eggs are completely set before portioning.
Cool cooked rice rapidly and keep refrigerated; avoid leaving rice at room temperature. Reheat rice thoroughly once.
Defrost frozen portions in the refrigerator. Re-crisp pastries, breaded vegetables and air-fried items in an oven or air fryer.
Keep delicate avocado, fresh salad, cold yogurt sauce and unbaked crisp toppings separate. They are generally not freezer-friendly.
